narr: A slow-moving summer frontal system, in conjunction with occasional disturbances embedded within the northwest flow aloft, generated multiple rounds of thunderstorms both preceding and during the Labor Day weekend. The predominant hazard observed was flash flooding, attributed to the substantial rainfall produced by some of these storms.
ev: A broadcast media video indicated flooding on northbound I-35E near Market Center Blvd in Dallas.
The city of Dallas FRWS gauges indicated that Luna Road at Y Street, and Tantor Road at X Street in northwest Dallas were flooded and closed.
A public report indicated that the westbound Interstate 30 frontage road was covered with one foot of water near the Erby Campbell exit.
A City of Dallas Flooded Roadway Warning System gauge indicated that the 7400 block of Merriman Pkwy was flooded and closed along White Rock Creek in Dallas.
A public report indicated that a car was stalled in flood waters near the intersection of Coit Road and Park Blvd in Plano.

Several roads were flooded and closed in Rowlett including Main St at the railroad trestle, Castle Dr at Dexham Rd, and Liberty Grove at Broadmoor. Springfield Park on Hwy 66 at Antioch Dr, and Dalrock Rd at Princeton Rd were also closed due to high water.
Garland PD closed Northwest Hwy at LBJ due to 2-3 feet of water on the roadway, and South 1st St at Centerville Rd and Duck Creek Dr was flooded.

City of Dallas FWRS system reported several roads flooded and closed across northern Dallas, including Luna Rd at Y Street, Tantor Rd at X Street, Goodnight at Walnut Hill Rd, 4201 St. Johns Drive, 7400 Merriman Pkwy, West Lawther at NW Hwy, and the 9500 blk of Lake Highlands Rd.
A social media report indicated that Main Street at the railroad trestle, and Castle Dr between Dexham Rd and Rowlett Rd, were flooded and closed in the city of Rowlett.
